original.title: Special Edition Pride 2023 ‘Daddy Chill’ Tee
original.description:
Our gender-neutral short sleeve fit with “Daddy Chill” screen printed on the front and a melange of iconic gender-bending queens and kings illustrated by Mexican-Persian artist, Dariush Alexander. Each one of these super-soft 100% cotton classics are cut, sewn, dyed, finished and printed in Downtown LA, down the street from where we roll all our joints.
50% of proceeds from the sale of this hat will be donated to The Knox Pride Community Center
FREE USPS First Class shipping on orders $100 and up!
Pride 2023 Collection
To celebrate Pride this year, we collaborated with Mexican-Persian artist, Dariush Alexander, to create an iconic suite of gender-bending queens and kings. Drag is an illusionary blend of masculine and feminine magic that reveals the power and freedom of true self-expression and individuality. An art form limited only by the edges of imagination. Always rooted in a powerful and rich tradition of dissidence in the name of radical self-love.
The Knox Pride Community Center
50% of proceeds from the Special Edition Daddy Chill 2023 Collection will be donated to The Knox Pride Community Center, based in Knoxville, TN. They provide a gender-affirming environment, support groups, resources, social events, food pantries, and clothing closets for homeless & LGBTQIA+ communities.
(If you're faced with the choice between buying Dad Grass or donating directly, please donate. But if you can do both, know we'll give back on your behalf.)
Dariush Alexander
Dariush Alexander AKA @hijx_de_laluna_ is an Iranian-Mexican artist who explores the relationship between myth, folklore, gender, and identity in his work. In addition to the spiritual and cultural manifestations of his roots, he incorporates historical, natural, and religious symbolism in a contemporary setting, which he refers to as post-folk.
Sizing
The sizing is pretty standard, with a nice boxy fit so it drapes just right on any body. It’s a unisex fit for dads, moms, and children of all ages! Refer to the size chart to figure out which will work best for you.
About Dad Grass Merch
Our special collections of apparel, accessories and smoking paraphernalia pay tribute to the timeless staples of dad style. Past, present and future. Like our hemp joints, flower and tinctures, Dad Grass merch is always simple, classic and of the highest quality.
